text:
The Grok Bot plugin marketplace is now open for submissions. Developers can submit a plugin or MCP server to reach Grok Bot and Cursor users, with Grok coming soon. You add your MCP server URL or a public GitHub repo, a short description and testing instructions, then choose where you want to be listed

Every submission is reviewed for the marketplace, so if you've built something that makes Grok Bot more useful, now is the time to get it in front of users

https://x.ai/bot/marketplace/submit-a-plugin
